# Contributing to BESHStatNG

Thanks for your interest in improving BESHStatNG.

## Before opening an issue

Please check the following first:

- the online help: https://beshstat.eu/beshstatng/help/latest/
- the tutorials: https://beshstat.eu/tutorials/
- the UDF cookbook: https://beshstat.eu/beshstatng-udf-cookbook/
- existing GitHub issues: https://github.com/PeterSlezak/BESHstatNG/issues

## Reporting bugs

Before opening a bug report, please try to:

- confirm the issue in a new or simplified workbook if possible
- restart Excel and test again
- note the exact BESHStatNG version, Excel version, Office bitness, and Windows version
- copy the exact formula, selected options, or dialog path
- remove confidential data before attaching files

## Good bug reports include

A good bug report should include:

- exact steps to reproduce the issue
- expected behavior
- actual behavior
- the full error text or stack trace, if available
- whether the issue affects GUI workflows, UDFs, charts, documentation, or installation
- screenshots, a workbook, or sample data if they help reproduce the issue

## Feature requests

Feature requests are welcome.

Please describe:

- the user problem you are trying to solve
- the proposed workflow or feature
- whether the request affects GUI workflows, UDFs, plots, documentation, or installation
- any examples from other software, papers, or references if relevant

## Validation notes for fixes

If you submit a fix, please describe how you validated it.

Helpful validation notes include:

- whether unit tests were added or updated
- whether the change was manually validated in Excel
- the workbook, sample data, or scenario used for testing
- whether the documentation or tutorials were updated if user-facing behavior changed

## Pull requests

Please keep pull requests focused and link the related issue when possible.

A good pull request should include:

- a short summary of the change
- the related issue number, if any
- validation notes
- screenshots or workbook notes if the change affects UI, charts, or worksheet output
- documentation updates when behavior or workflow changed

## Security and sensitive data

Please do not attach confidential workbooks or sensitive data to public issues or pull requests. Redact or simplify files before uploading them.
